data.name: Cubics Cube
data.detailed_description:
Cubics Cube is a nostalgic blend of Bejeweled, Balatro, and the classic Rubik's Cube, with a modern roguelike twist. Upgrade your cube as you progress through increasingly difficult rounds. Form patterns, complete faces, or solve the cube while experimenting with numerous cube-breaking modifiers and effects.

Key Features

10+ unique game modes

Play more than 10 unique game modes including:

  • Our Classic Cubics Cube Mode

    • A roguelike experience where you upgrade your cube and tailor your playstyle with various Cubics, Gubics, and Zubics

  • Zen Mode

    • A relaxing experience where you can practice and play with your cube

  • Speed-Cubing Mode

    • A fast-paced experience where you can speed-solve your cube and fight for a spot on the Steam leaderboards

    • Featuring an optional full keyboard layout, along with hotkeys for quickly changing cube orientation while executing algorithms with your interaction method of choice

  • Over 10 more unique unlockable game modes

A satisfying virtual cube

Play with a satisfying virtual cube, featuring various interaction modes, wide and double moves, and a range of hotkeys for orienting your cube.

  • Tactile Mode

    • Use your mouse to flick your cube as if you were holding the real thing

  • Keyboard Mode

    • Use the WASD keys and your mouse to swiftly rotate your cube

  • Edge Detection Mode

    • Use your mouse to hover over the edge of your cube and click to confirm your move

Additional Features

  • Upgrade your cube with over 50 Cubics, including Boosters, Boons, Portals, Crystals, and Stars

  • Experiment with different strategies using over 100 Gubics as you build your own unique cube

  • Strategize against over 20 Zubics, each creating a new challenge for your run
